name: sellersheet-skills
description: Run your Amazon business by talking to your AI — no ERP. Pull orders and settlements, bulk-edit listings, build FBA shipments, tune SP/SB/SD bids and budgets, query inventory and search-term reports, and generate compliant listing images and A+ — across multiple stores and marketplaces, with every result written to Google Sheets for you to review. 不用 ERP，对 AI 说需求就能运营亚马逊店铺：查订单和结算、批量改 Listing、建 FBA 货件、调广告出价预算、拉库存与搜索词报表、生成合规主图与 A+；支持多店铺多站点，结果写进 Google 表格供你审核。
